title: Reunion in the Shadows of Kisii

start.speaker: Wanje wa Mwadorikola
start.text: Mekatilili! Psst! Over here by the stockade wall! I heard the guards speaking of an escape attempt. You slipped out of the women's compound?

choices.text: The British guards are careless at night, Wanje. We are leaving tonight.
I promised the council we would not abandon our people. Where are the keys?

node_wanje_keys.speaker: Wanje wa Mwadorikola
node_wanje_keys.text: The sergeant left the iron gate key hanging inside the stone guardhouse on the western veranda. Evade the perimeter lanterns, seize the keys, and unlock this iron bar!

choices.text: Stay ready, Wanje. I will retrieve the key.

node_finish_wanje.speaker: Mekatilili wa Menza
node_finish_wanje.text: Move silently. The shadow of the night belongs to us.
